items.text: Supposing today were Monday would tomorrow be Sunday?
Would you be making a profit if you sold your car for half its price?
Is it easy to guess the correct numbers of the lottery?
Does the temperature decrease as we move from Autumn to Winter?
Is the shoulder one of the joints of the arm?
Can we use “Yes, I do” as a short answer?
Is it true that we don´t have to consider carefully before making decisions?
Can we use a rope for cooking?
Do we generally shorten our trousers when they are too long?
Is an ache a continuous physical pain?
Is “to feel rough” the same as “to feel well”?
Must we put something under one of a table´s legs when it´s not level?
Are educated people the same as polite people?
Can we feel hungry after overeating?
Is it common for people to pay the service charge in restaurants?
Would I be your guest if you invited me to your house?
Is an employee a person who employs somebody to work for them?
Is a rough drawing a very simple drawing?
Can a couple adopt a child if they can´t have one?
Do newspapers have the legal right to print stories that aren´t true?
Although he has lain in bed
for several hours,
he is still awake.
They did not notice
the strange- looking house.
When people owe us a lot of money,
we ought really to have a piece of paper
with their signature on it
and the amount they owe.
The servant took great pride
in his work at the palace.
The lorry ran over some glass,
and so we had to get out
and change
one of the wheels.
